additional_info.subject: TH SichargeD MP / R3 170001691 : Charger Offline (OCPP Communication Issue)
additional_info.body:
Dear Support Team/Helpdesk,
I am writing to report a technical issue with our
SICHARGE-D 300 kW
charging station. Currently, the unit is unable to connect to our backend system via
OCPP (Offline)
.
Current Status:
LED Indicator:
The LED light strip is showing a
solid white
color constantly.
Connectivity:
We have inspected both internet router sets at the site. Both routers are functioning normally and have a stable signal (please see the attached images for reference).
Screen Status:
The display is stuck on the
"Hallo / Hello"
screen and is completely unresponsive to touch. It does not proceed to the main menu.
Despite the routers having an active internet connection, the charger remains offline in our management system. We would appreciate it if you could investigate this matter and provide us with a solution or troubleshooting steps to restore the OCPP connection.
SIcharge D
Serial Number: MP / R3 170001691
--

additional_info.subject: ID0471289-DC/Si-D/TH- [MP / R3 170001691] Charger Offline CRM:03289000175
additional_info.body:
Hello Ping, good evening. I hope you are doing well.
I checked this charger and the problem is related to FW. It is unrecoverable and needs to be flashed again.
I will send you a guide of what is needed to perform this task and what is expected:
1. Buy a CFAST card reader, here's an example from Amazon:
2. Turn off the charger either by:
2.1 - putting PLC to Stop and press FC12) or;
2.2 - open the door of the charger and select shutdown in the HMI.
3. Remove the CFAST card from the PLC of the charger (KF1), it's inside this latch:
3. Insert the CFAST in the reader and connect to the computer.
4. Download the flashing software in:
www.rufus.ie
and run it. Select the CFAST card in the "Device" and select the FW that I will send in another email:
5. After this is finished, please remove it with safety and insert it back in the charger.
6. When the charger is back online, you will see something similar to this:
7. Please provide me these 2 parameters and I will bring the charger back to operation by configuring everything.
The email with the FW will follow in a few minutes. When you receive the FW, you need to extract it. Be aware that the FW is around ~90Gb so you need a bit of storage in the computer.
Let me know if everything was clear.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0471289-DC/Si-D/TH- [MP / R3 170001691] Charger Offline CRM:03289000175
additional_info.body:
Hello Ping,
In theory it is possible, from my point of view, if you get a SIM card in one router and connect a LAN cable between both WAN ports, I can remotely test and find what's the best.
What is your opinion?
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
